checks.reason: Exact varifold decomposition gives unweighted E1; two-phase sigma2 distinct smooth concentric circles have Evar=E1>0 while E_sigma=2E1. Weighted cyclic normals for tensions1,1,sqrt2 sum to0 but unweighted normals do not, blocking the cited general-tension phase cancellation. This is a material varifold scope/proof defect; common equal tension can normalize, and no full global Theorem19 or principal BV counterexample is claimed.

Replacing n with n-xi drops(1-|xi|2)(B dot xi)w; xi=e1/2,n=B=e1,w1 gives3/8 residual. Young absorption follows from existing shortness/coercivity. Dropped E(0) in48 contradicts T-to0 continuity for distinct smooth circles but is already correctly present in Proposition17 and Theorem3; restoring it repairs stability.

The bounded-profile Fourier assumption is unchanged by setting f(pi/8)=0 at a single point, while distinct orientations then have zero tension. Continuous profile sqrt(1/4+g0) separately violates diagonal normalization. Continuity and f(0)=0 recover the intended Fejer/Vandermonde use. Actual Read-Shockley profile has those properties.

Independent coefficient algebra gives5alpha2/27-7alpha4/750, not the paired expression's -alpha4/750; threshold1250/63. No numerical integration or author code used.

Source conventions give mixed strain=-(tau H+gamma H+n gamma). An actual shrinking-circle flow and gamma=exp(-s/R) obey75 but violate76 by2/R at distance0. In the permitted interface wedge,164 identifies Bp with101;188 near endpoint sets gamma_c=alpha. Printed75 and105 then force Dn(Bp-Bc)=-2alpha H tau and first-order difference -2alpha H s tau, contradicting187/186 wherever alpha H is nonzero. Eq104 excludes identically vanishing alpha H on an open curved overlap segment; flat special cases are not claimed to fail. Construction38 and Lemmas41/42 actually use these estimates. However the leading matrix difference is-2alpha H tau tensor n, whose transpose annihilates n; no counterexample to277/271 or main theorem follows solely from this.
